abstract.p: The present invention relates inter alia to fertile non-human vertebrates such as mice and rats useful for producing antibodies bearing human variable regions, in which endogenous antibody chain expression has been inactivated. This inactivation leads to loss of ADAM6 genes located within the rodent heavy chain locus, said genes being crucial for fertility. Introduction of functional copies of said ADAM6 genes allows production of fertile mice.
